how: Project name list, fixed at compile time. Translations and action events must use these names for `task`, `after_task` and `running`. A running entry names a task that is still in progress. Anything else uses 'other:<words>' and will not match. Extended for the boundary test (round 2) with names used by its compiled rules.

all_folders.test: run the test suite or any test subset
all_folders.restart: restart a running service or server

AbuShaqra__TC_PLC_Toolkit.other:download and launch vs code for a: download and launch vs code for a probe
